content.comment_body: Hello, My [product_name] sometimes isn't recognized by [product_name]. Despite the ethernet connection icon being active, I can't view the IP address in any of the communication windows, causing failed communication attempts. Both my computer (192.168.0.100) and the [product_name] (192.168.0.9) are on the same subnet (255.255.255.0). Occasionally, I am able to connect, but not consistently. Additionally, I notice a blinking star character on the top right of the [product_name] display. Thank you

Hi, It seems you have at least three devices connected: the [product_name], your PC, and a [product_name] operator panel. Please provide all relevant IP details. Are there any other devices on this network? Also, the small blinking star in the display corner indicates active communication. Hope that helps.
No, it is a 24V AC or DC model. Thanks.

I think the operator panel's IP address is 192.168.0.8 or .10, but I'm not completely sure. The main issue is that while the [product_name] and its panel communicate, I can't view the device IP in [product_name] software. Today, I found that [product_name] was being blocked by Windows Firewall. I plan to have our IT staff allow the program and test again. Could the firewall be causing this connectivity problem? Thanks again for your support.
A new question published by [user_name] was moved to a separate thread titled 'Download a PC-[product_name] program to [product_name] does not work.' Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience inconsistent connectivity between the [product_name] and [product_name] software, reporting that the device recognition is unreliable despite visible ethernet connection. Users are unclear about some display symbols and want greater transparency regarding network setup and troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate stable recognition of their devices by the [product_name] software and clearer communication status indicators. They also want improved explanations for symbols shown on devices and effective troubleshooting support.
